marine.text:
Wind northwest 30 knots diminishing to northwest 20 late this
afternoon then backing to west 15 late this evening. Wind diminishing to light
early Thursday morning then increasing to southwest 20 Thursday
evening. Scattered flurries ending Thursday morning. Visibility as
low as 1 mile in flurries. Temperatures near minus 5. <br/>
